graph.title: Build a Robot (HTML & CSS image positioning)
notes: This tutorial is a software-only HTML/CSS web-design project (positioning robot face, eyes and mouth images with CSS in the Raspberry Pi code editor). It contains no Arduino, Raspberry Pi GPIO, breadboard, wires, LEDs or any other physical electronic or LEGO parts.
The 'robot' is made of on-screen images (face, eyes1-3, mouth1) styled with CSS, not physical components, so there are no nodes or edges to extract. The graph is intentionally empty.
No external LED circuit or hardware is listed in the manual.
